curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: form the letters Aa, Mm, Tt and Ee in their correct shapes and sizes

mission.title: Aa Mm Tt Ee Letter Studio

interactions.prompt: Match each capital letter to its small letter.
interactions.feedback: Perfect partners! Each capital has its small form.
interactions.retryHint: Say each letter name while finding its partner.

interactions.prompt: Put the strokes for capital T in order.
items: Draw a line across the top
Start at the middle of that line
answer: Draw a line across the top
Start at the middle of that line
interactions.feedback: That makes a clear capital T.
interactions.retryHint: The top line comes before the downward line.

interactions.prompt: Build capital E by tapping its strokes in order.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap each stroke in writing order.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! Your E has one long line and three lines across.
interactions.retryHint: Make the long back first, then add top, middle and bottom.

interactions.prompt: Which lowercase m has the correct shape and size?
choices: m with one short stem and two rounded humps
M as tall as a capital
interactions.answer: m with one short stem and two rounded humps
interactions.feedback: Correct! Lowercase m is short and has two humps.
interactions.retryHint: Count two rounded humps after the short stem.

interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a letter, then its size group.
interactions.feedback: Great sorting! Capital and small letters have suitable sizes.
interactions.retryHint: Capital letters belong in the tall group.

interactions.prompt: Which row shows all four correct capital-small pairs?
interactions.feedback: Letter studio complete! You know each shape and size.
interactions.retryHint: Check that every tall capital is followed by its small partner.
